You are going to find honesty, compassion and expert care at  University Dental Associates. University Dental Associates worked with me on costs and treatment choices.  No good dental work is cheap, but I have no regrets in spending the money.  It did take some budgeting, but again I have no regrets.
I would like to end this review with my sincere thanks to assistants Belen and Nicole.  You two are very much the brand of University Dental Associated.
